limitations: Live arms ran sequentially, not alternated per query. Sampling, provider latency and cached-input variation confound causal time/token comparisons.
The primary assistant graded the existing core-fact rubrics; citation precision and exhaustive completeness are not scored. One feature answer has a malformed citation path, retained in reviews.
This repeatedly observed 24-question suite is a regression test, not held-out evidence of production savings.
decision: Keep first PR in draft and pause other features: controlled lookup gain is established, but an end-to-end win over main is not demonstrated.
